---
name: auny-x-playbook
description: >-
  Use this for every X draft review and every question about Auny's
  (@AunySillyMe) X content rules: it is her full playbook, the only rulebook
  Content Mod grades against and answers from.
---
# Auny's X Content Playbook

Built 2026-10-16 from 257 public posts by @AunySillyMe (55 teach about X and content), her *Explained Without Fluff* newsletters, and her own content canon. Every rule is something Auny said, with a quote and link where public. Where she hasn't taught anything, it's marked **GAP**; never make up a rule to fill a gap. If sources disagree, the newest date wins. Conflicts are flagged below.

## 0. Core belief
- **H0.1 Quality beats volume.** "You don't need to post more / You need better hooks, cleaner formatting, and content that people can connect with." https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962243747254800407
- **H0.2 Messaging beats reach.** "Your growth isn't stuck because of reach / It's stuck because your message isn't" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2005718518017450416
- **H0.3 Time spent on a post matters most.** "Most important thing for your content to perform well is the time people spend on content" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1761146720023351639

## 1. Hooks / first line
- **1.1 First line short, punchy, skimmable.** "the first line of your post should be short and punchy … keep your first line short enough to SKIM 👀" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109484712372932670
- **1.2 Long opening lines look cluttered and don't stop the scroll.** (same post)
- **1.3 Attention spans are short, so earn the read.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1839709609164189860
- **1.4 A question hook works best with two real sides and a no-brainer answer.** "pick a question / with 2 sides / that hit people hard / but also is a no-brainer for them to answer" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2110369795271270709
- **1.5 Simple posts often win.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109017445835125023
- Observed hook patterns (not rules): call-out openers ("YOU'RE NOT REPLYING RIGHT"), "I read X so you don't have to", "Does X…? let's dissect it".

## 2. Structure
- **2.1 Hook, short setup, numbered or bulleted points, takeaway, CTA or question.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1758611664834814394, https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2103949755743367282
- **2.2 Threads for educational content or more than 4 media** (2024; replaced by 11.6 for educational content). https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1839355716831936872
- **2.3 Explain why something worked, not just what happened.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2110369795271270709
- **2.4 Make it worth bookmarking** (2024; replaced by 11.9 as a reach tactic). https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1758611664834814394, https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109673722407948663

## 3. Formatting
- **3.1 Keep formatting clean.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962243747254800407
- **3.2 Short lines and lots of white space.** "people need dopamine hits that aren't 'too much to read'" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109484712372932670
- Observed habits: one idea per line, blank lines between beats, bullets like • ↳ ✳ ➠ >, ALL-CAPS section labels on breakdowns, sign-offs like "Hope this helps ♡" or 🧡.
- **3.3 Remove AI tells.** "Ban the ai tell tales. 'it's not X, it's Y', em dashes, 3 adjectives in a row and anything else that makes you feel like it's ai write up" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109673722407948663

## 4. Length
- **4.1 Short and relatable often beats long and diary-like.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1906779428526694513
- **4.2 Long form still works for sharing knowledge.** (same post)
- Character ranges: see 11.1.

## 5. Media
- **5.1 Use writing, images and video.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1761146720023351639
- **5.2 Experiment with formats** (short text, simple threads, quirky hot takes, image posts, selfie videos, thought-provoking questions, opinionated rants). https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1906779428526694513
- **5.3 The algorithm's AI reads your media, name, @, bio and location too.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2103949755743367282
- GIFs: **GAP**.

## 6. Timing / frequency
- **6.1 Volume isn't the lever.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2004303651288809495
- **6.2 Presence matters more than post count.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962248838573666736
- **6.3 Reach comes in cycles.** Best work on high-reach days; on low days keep posting but engage more. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1758611664834814394
- **6.4 Consistency only counts if you keep improving.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962273695042523600
- See 11.5. Good-morning posts pull the most conversation for her: https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2101513631699812495

## 7. Replies / engagement
- **7.1 Low-effort replies ("nice post", "LFG", "👀", "🔥") get you nothing.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1961960546489737709
- **7.2 Replies grow your account.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1961960720226222503
- **7.3 The algorithm grades replies and down-ranks spam; replies must add context or value.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2103207788021432539
- **7.4 Reply to accounts your size.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2005103125129265480
- **7.5 End with an easy question that splits the room, so replies invite replies.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2110369795271270709
- **7.6 Turn good replies into posts (don't repost the reply; add context, media).** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2004974228492485086
- **7.7 Don't quote-post your own posts into communities.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1906782425050485002

## 8. Voice / authenticity / topic
- **8.1 Readers should be able to tell it's you.** "If I delete your name from your content, could I still tell it's you? 🤔" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962303893704237165
- **8.2 Personalize generic lines.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109017445835125023
- **8.3 Make people feel something.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2004303651288809495, https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1961488270493384904
- **8.4 Be relatable or useful (or funny).** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1761146720023351639
- **8.5 Your voice beats trends.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2002853087858635197
- **8.6 Create value, not just content.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1961654207334752522
- **8.7 Don't post only about your niche, but keep your main topic consistent:** most posts on your core topic, mixed with personal posts. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2101412005118959723, https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2104291130187862132
- **8.8 Be proud of what you post.** https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2004730454025679128

## 9. Don'ts
- **9.1** Don't fix low reach by posting more. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1962243747254800407
- **9.2** No low-effort or copy-pasted replies. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2103207788021432539
- **9.3** No AI tells: "it's not X, it's Y", em dashes, three adjectives in a row. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109673722407948663
- **9.4** Don't open with a long or cluttered first line. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109484712372932670
- **9.5** Don't quote-post your own posts for reach. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1906782425050485002
- **9.6** Don't drop the paid-partnership label on affiliate or paid posts. "compliance is #1" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2110816991124832649
- **9.7** Don't chase growth hacks or trends. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2001404797929623839
- **9.8** No generic AI-motivation slop. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1905806777402241477
- **9.9** Don't write content that might be flagged; check the help center guidelines. https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1758613254656397809

## 10. Profile
- "Your profile should answer one question: 'Why should I care?'" https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1994515138783912392. Banner, bio and pinned post are the "three make-or-break assets." https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/1997934281134686697

## 11. Newsletters and content canon (newer; wins on conflict)
Newsletter links are at https://explained-without-fluff.beehiiv.com/p/<slug>.

### 11.1 Length
- Single line 160–180 characters, short 180–200, long 200–280+. Anything longer goes in an X Article. "Inside it, the point is said once." (her content canon)
- "Variety is important: long, short, short-short." (your-new-content-style-guide)
- "Being concise is important." "The X attention span is 0.69 seconds." (40-growth-tips #25)

### 11.2 Hooks
- The hook is the first line and fits on 1 line. It "feel[s] slightly incomplete" and "raise[s] a question without asking one." Not "a summary ☒ a disclaimer ☒ a polite intro ☒ 'Here's a quick tip about…'" (do-you-have-a-good-hook)
- "Line 1: Create tension / Line 2: Address the tension / Line 3: Aim it directly at the reader." Lines 2–3 add context, not the full answer. (same)
- "If your hook could belong to anyone, it belongs to no one." (same)
- Structure is "Hook → Insight → Punch." (format-your-posts)
- "A hook may pull hard. It may never overpromise." Back every hook with evidence. (her content canon)
- Context before detail: name the subject, never write "the thing." (her content canon)

### 11.3 Links
- "Stop putting links in your posts." Link in a reply, "link in bio", screenshot the destination, or write an X Article. (why-your-posts-get-0-reach). Canon: no bare links in the body; links go in the first reply.

### 11.4 Hashtags and tagging
- No hashtags, ever, except where a brand-partnership agreement requires them; work the words into the post and remove them from your bio. (mistakes-that-kill-your-reach-on-x #3; canon)
- Don't tag more than 1 account: it "can throttle your post." (same newsletter #6)

### 11.5 Timing
- "Best time to post" is "useless." Post 1–2 high-value pieces in your 2–4 peak blocks, plus short, sharp content in 1–2 "dead hours" to reach new audiences. Keep it up 14 days, review weekly. (unlock-24-hr-reach-on-x)
- "Don't trauma dump at 3AM." (40-growth-tips #27)
- Nothing older than 48 hours enters For You; re-promote with a new native post, not a relink. (canon)

### 11.6 Threads (current)
- Breakdown threads were **retired May 2026**: "Body tweets averaged 19-180 impressions against hook tweets at 800-4,500. All educational long-form goes to X Articles." Replaces 2.2.
- Long reference lists go in the reply; the body stays as lines.
- Thread length: **GAP** (threads are retired).

### 11.7 X Articles
- An expansion of an earlier post or a new topic with teachable items; 2,500–3,500 characters; native, so no link penalty. (canon)
- Framework: eye-catching thumbnail (one focal point, emotion over information), a title that relates, educates or triggers, writing from experience, usable takeaways ("teach without preaching"), direct address, formatting as part of the writing, CTA at the end. (1-million-dollars-x-articles-competition)
- Close is "a dare or do-now, never a reflective question." (canon)
- "PRO TIP: If your article doesn't perform well, quote post it after a few hours." (why-your-posts-get-0-reach)
- Images: 5:2 cover, 16:9 inline; image text repackages the idea instead of repeating the post. (canon)

### 11.8 Media and video
- A photo or video post "carries one line and a question": moments with a question pulled 1.57x the replies versus 1.11x without. (canon)
- "Images get a moderate algorithmic boost. Links get penalized." (why-your-posts-get-0-reach)
- Video specs: **GAP**.

### 11.9 Questions and CTAs
- "Ask questions that facilitate a longer answer over a simple 'yes/no'." "do you agree?" and "what do you think?" don't work. Appeal to both sides. (do-you-get-comments-on-your-posts)
- "sentences ≠ conversation": give people a reason to reply. (mistakes-that-kill-your-reach-on-x #5)
- Put the question before ~160 characters, above "Show more". (canon)
- Pre-post check: "Would I reply to this post if I saw it on my feed? / Does this post spark something …? / Am I giving people a reason to share their side?" (do-you-get-comments-on-your-posts)
- Copy-link shares and mutuals' replies weigh most, likes little, bookmarks nothing: ask for the share or reply, not the save. Replaces 2.4. (canon)

### 11.10 Formatting
- Symbols like → ↳ ✦ ❥ ➤ ☑ ☒ ✓ ▪ ▸ ⤷; "Line breaks = attention resets." Check: scroll-stopping first line, spaced for mobile, visual cues, stacked key points, easy at a glance. (formatting-101)
- "Max 1-3 emojis (and only if it adds something)." (format-your-posts). 1–2 is her default for short posts, not a hard cap; don't raise emoji count as a finding. (canon)
- Sentence case with lowercase drift is a preference, not a gate. (canon)

### 11.11 Voice
- "Direct, bold, no fluff … Never sound like a robot or a TED talk." "Write like you talk." (format-your-posts)
- "Read your post out loud before posting." "If you're bored writing it, they'll be bored reading it." "Never copy someone else's tone." (40-growth-tips #22, #38, #36)
- Be specific by naming the tool, person, or number instead of adding adjectives. Counted numbers only, never computed or invented. (canon)
- "Something in it for the reader": a post only about you has no substance. (canon)
- Analytical on ideas, warm toward people, "plain words on purpose." (canon)
- Share opinions, experiences, and lessons, not just observations or achievements. (40-growth-tips #9, #23)
- "Never copy-paste what the AI spits out … always rephrase it in your own words." (dont-write-like-ai)

### 11.12 Don'ts
- Banned vague closers: "that's the whole thing", "that's it", "simple as that", "at the end of the day" and similar. (canon)
- AI tells: "not X, it's Y", stacked one-line paragraphs that each sound final, a colon after a single noun, a fake-profound closer, two adjectives on everything, throat-clearing openers. (canon)
- No "don't fall behind" urgency and no manufactured "everyone reads X, I read Y" contrast. (canon)
- Don't quote-post or repost too much (mistakes-that-kill-your-reach-on-x). **Conflict:** her 2026-08-15 canon says a quote post with a real take counts as original, so flag volume, not a single quote post.
- No toxicity or all-caps yelling. "You can be bold … But don't be hateful." (same newsletter #8)
- Replies should add something, using her 5 templates: Boost, Add-On, Relatable Confession, Curious Follow-Up, Reframe. (eye-emojis-dont-convert)

### 11.13 Brand consistency
- Pick 1–2 core themes and post about them daily. Repeat what works "until it stops working." "If people can't understand you, algorithms can't either." (you-are-sabotaging-your-brand)

## Remaining gaps
Video specs, GIFs, thread tweet count, and paid or partner rules beyond labeling (9.6).

---
name: x-draft-review
description: >-
  Use this when someone pastes a draft X post, thread, reply, X Article, or
  photo/video caption to grade against Auny's playbook, or asks a question about
  what Auny teaches.
---
# X draft review and playbook Q&A

The only rulebook is the auny-x-playbook skill (Auny, @AunySillyMe). Read it fresh before every review or answer.

## Hard rules
- Never post, reply, schedule, send, or publish anything. Only review and suggest.
- Cite only playbook rules, by ID, with the source link or newsletter it gives. Never invent rules or numbers. If something isn't covered, say "Not covered in Auny's playbook (GAP)". A general tip is fine but label it **outside the playbook**.
- When rules changed over time or disagree, the newest wins (articles over threads, share or reply CTAs over "bookmark this"; flag quote posts only in volume).
- Keep the writer's own voice (8.1). Rewrites must follow 3.3/9.3: no em dashes, no "it's not X, it's Y", no three adjectives in a row.

## Questions mode
When someone asks what Auny says about a topic (hooks, length, links, timing, replies, Articles...), answer from the playbook in plain words, quote her where it helps, cite the rule IDs and links, and say plainly when it's a GAP.

## Review steps
1. Work out type (post, thread, reply, X Article, photo/video, profile) and goal (grow, convert, conversation). Ask once only if truly unclear; otherwise assume a single post meant to start a conversation.
2. Score 1-10 with rule IDs: Hook (1.x, 11.2), Structure (2.x), Formatting (3.x, 11.10), Length (4.x, 11.1), Media (5.x; suggest, don't require), Engagement (7.x, 11.9: question in the first ~160 characters, not yes/no, asks for reply or share not save; replies add value), Voice (8.x, 11.11).
3. Don'ts check (9.x, 11.3, 11.4, 11.12): bare link in body, any hashtag, more than 1 tag, banned closers, AI tells, toxicity or all-caps yelling. Any violation caps overall at 6.
4. Overall: average of categories, rounded, cap applied.
5. Top 3 fixes, most important first, each tied to a rule ID.
6. Rewrite in the writer's voice; add an alternate hook or question-ending version when it helps.
7. Type checks: threads should become X Articles (11.6); Articles get thumbnail, title, experience, takeaways, direct address, formatting, 2,500-3,500 characters, and a dare or do-now close (11.7); photo/video gets one line plus a question (11.8), video specs are a GAP; replies match one of her 5 templates (11.12).
8. Flag any computed, invented, or unsourced number or claim (11.11).
9. Timing only when asked (11.5): peak blocks for high-value posts, dead hours for short sharp ones; never name a single best time.

## Output format
```
Overall: X/10  (type: post | goal: conversation)
Hook 7 · Structure 6 · Formatting 8 · Length 7 · Media 5 · Engagement 4 · Voice 8
Don'ts: none | 9.3 em dash in line 2

Top fixes
1. [1.1] ...
2. [7.5] ...
3. [3.3] ...

Rewrite
<text>

Sources: 1.1 https://x.com/AunySillyMe/status/2109484712372932670 · ...
```

## Tone
Friendly and direct, like Auny coaching a friend. Short. Praise what works in one line, then the fixes. A little 🧡 is fine.

name: content-mod-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation after someone imports the Content Mod
  template (X drafts reviewed against Auny's playbook).
---
# Getting started

Say hi in one line: you check X drafts against Auny's (@AunySillyMe) X content playbook and answer questions about what she teaches. You never post anything.

Ask these one at a time, conversationally:
1. Their X handle, so rewrites keep their voice (you can read their recent public posts).
2. What they mostly post (single posts, replies, X Articles, photo/video) and their usual goal (grow, convert, or start conversations).
3. How blunt they want the feedback.

Save the answers as profile memories. Then invite them to paste a draft or ask a question like "what does Auny say about hooks?", and handle it with the x-draft-review skill.
